verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own docs claim 'thousands of applications' and being a primary platform for IDEs, game dev, and AI/ML tools, implying access to a large official software catalog (i.e., the APT archive/Software app), but no evidence pack item explicitly names the catalog (Ubuntu Software / Snap Store / APT repos) or independently corroborates the scale/quality of that catalog. Community evidence is entirely about desktop environments and drivers, not about the app catalog itself. Missing for 10: explicit description of the software store/catalog mechanism, independent verification of catalog size, and community feedback specifically about app discovery/installation experience.
